objective: Implement and locally verify one authenticated, digest-bound repository-delivery worker that converts an immutable verified Release Seven candidate into an exact private checkpoint, feature-branch commit, push, and draft pull request without merge or deployment authority.

protectedAction.target: one exact verified Release Seven candidate, one unique private checkpoint ref, one unique target feature branch, and one draft pull request

implementationSequence: add strict delivery proposal, approval, candidate-evidence, commit, provider-step, partial-failure, and result contracts
add deterministic checkpoint-ref, feature-branch, commit-message, and draft-pull-request derivation
add Release Seven evidence and candidate-diff revalidation
add disposable reconstruction workspace with offline dependency and bootstrap controls
add fixed full verification before commit or provider mutation
add deterministic single-parent commit and exact tree verification
add checkpoint-first private publication and provider-authoritative equality proof
add target feature-branch push and provider-authoritative equality proof
add exact draft-pull-request creation and verification
add partial-failure, rollback, credential-clearance, canonical-nonmutation, and cleanup evidence
add authenticated Command Center Deliver view and gateway endpoints
add adversarial, integration, browser, and fictional real-provider delivery verification
excludedAuthority: editing canonical working trees, indexes, configurations, hooks, or main refs
delivery of any candidate not exactly bound to an immutable verified Release Seven result
force-push, ref update, tag creation, merge, rebase, squash, review submission, ready-for-review, release, or deployment

dependency version, manifest, lockfile, workflow, generated bundle, binary, mode, rename, or deletion changes
model shell, Git, credential, provider, browser, tool, or network authority

rollback: Stop before the next provider boundary on failure; preserve any already-created immutable private checkpoint or target ref as explicit evidence; remove only the contained local disposable workspace and temporary local branch; clear credentials and approval state; prove canonical worktrees and main refs unchanged; and require a new Founder-approved proposal for any remote closure, deletion, retry, repair, or merge.
reapproval: Required for implementation; every delivery activation; every retry or repair; any different repository, base, Release Seven result, candidate digest, file manifest, commit metadata, checkpoint ref, target branch, pull-request field, provider operation, credential mechanism, command, limit, workspace root, network destination, cleanup action, cost, merge, deployment, or protected scope.
